enabled.name: ./seo/enabled
enabled.text: Emit Schema.org / JSON-LD on this page

mode.fieldDescription: How page-level Schema.org data combines with template defaults.
mode.name: ./seo/mode

type.fieldDescription: Main schema.org type for this page.
type.name: ./seo/type

articleHelp.text: These fields apply only to Article, NewsArticle, and BlogPosting types.

eventLocationUrl.fieldDescription: Used as schema:VirtualLocation when no physical address is set.
eventLocationUrl.name: ./seo/eventLocationUrl

faqHelp.text: Each question/answer pair becomes a schema:Question with an acceptedAnswer. Use only genuine Q&A content.

jobLocationType.fieldDescription: Set to TELECOMMUTE for fully remote roles.
jobLocationType.name: ./seo/jobLocationType

headline.fieldDescription: schema:headline / og:title override. Leave blank to fall back to jcr:title.
headline.name: ./seo/headline

description.fieldDescription: schema:description. Leave blank to fall back to jcr:description.
description.name: ./seo/description

keywords.fieldDescription: Each value becomes a schema:keywords entry.

wizardNotice.text: The AI generator reads your page body to produce Schema.org markup. Add content to the page, then open Page Properties to use Generate with AI.

aiHelp.text: Drafts JSON-LD from the current page content. Review before saving.

aiPrompt.fieldDescription: Extra guidance for the AI (e.g. 'emphasize local SEO', 'include FAQ items').
aiPrompt.name: ./seo/aiPrompt

jsonLd.fieldDescription: Raw JSON-LD. When present this is emitted verbatim. The AI button fills this field.
jsonLd.name: ./seo/jsonLd
